basics.name: Václav Lorenc
basics.label: Principal Information Security Engineer
basics.summary: Information security engineer and architect with extensive experience in vulnerability management, SIEM architecture, incident response, malware analysis, and Secure SDLC implementation. Strong background in automation, forensic investigations, and security process improvements across enterprise environments.

work.name: HERE Czech Republic
work.summary: Directed the architectural design and execution of enterprise-wide vulnerability management frameworks.
highlights: Engineered automated systems for threat escalation, queue management, and remediation planning, significantly enhancing risk visibility.
Maintained, scaled, and documented proprietary security infrastructure to ensure continuous operational compliance.
Drove continuous process improvements focusing on automation and rigorous documentation standards.

work.name: Konica Minolta

Led foundational security-focused data analytics training for monitoring teams.

work.name: Oracle + NetSuite
work.position: Senior Security Analyst / SOC Tier1 Manager

Ensured the effective handling of log data and integration with related tools under varying levels of uncertainty.

Conducted independent malware reverse engineering and advanced forensics to support threat analysis and incident response.
